rationale: EO 11241 (August 26, 1965) only amended subparagraphs (3) and (4) of paragraph (a) of section 1631.7 of the Selective Service Regulations, with effect from its own date, so its command was performed on issue. The regulation text it created ended when EO 11497 of November 26, 1969, section 3, revoked paragraphs (a) and (b) of section 1631.7 and prescribed a new paragraph (a), and EO 12553 of February 25, 1986 revoked the Executive Orders in its list, and any amendments to them, including No. 11241, Amending Selective Service regulations. Both held orders were read in full. The catalog observation (revoked by EO 12553, February 25, 1986) and the 1989 codification observation (revoked, actor EO 12553) agree with the held text of EO 12553. The U.S. Code and eCFR searches found no hit for the order and no later source continues it. No part of the order survives: it has no continuing duty, and no saving clause appears in EO 11497 or EO 12553.
